subject: arrival-engineering: the capability wiring graph at rest

cases.note: Every tie in the live bundle holds: clauses to kernel, prose to driver tables, receipts to producer, arrival to receipts.
The driver's own selftest: planted islands found, controls clean, blinded instrument reds, planted SHADOW write refused.
Twelve planted hollowings, each of which must red exactly one tie.
The planted fixture tree yields exactly the island classes the driver declares, and nothing it cannot name.
A properly bound capability and a true documented pin produce no finding at all.
The committed receipts.json is exactly what its producer renders, twice.
A row with no resolvable receipt is refused at append, not parked as a to-do.
Deleting one L0 kernel entry breaks the count tie with the clauses.
A factually harmless hand edit to receipts.json still reds: evidence regenerates through its producer.
A row recorded PRODUCTION on a declaration receipt reds, which is the whole ledger discipline in one assertion.
An understated row reds too: the arrival column equals what the receipts support, so a row nobody remembered to raise is caught by the same tie that catches an over-claim.
A6 repointed away from context-closure-engineering reds: the closure law has one tested copy and it is not here.
A diagnostic the driver emits but the page stops documenting reds the doc/driver tie.
A judge input carrying a giveaway token measures reading comprehension instead of a refusal.
SKILL.md that stops defining a level the driver can emit reds: this bundle is the vocabulary's single owner, so an undefined level has no owner at all.
